generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least Two financial years an average annual financial turnover Rs.8.45 lakhs. With Profit and loss details and Certified Turnover Certificate issued by the Chartered accountant with UDIN Number i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26

Satisfactory Complete as prime contractor of any work of value not less than Rs.2.50 lakhs certified by the Executive Engineer

BANKERS CERTIFICATE or LINE OF CREDIT, Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. 3.00 Lakhs or Credit lines / letter of credit / certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc
Reserved category CAT-IIA Certificate to be furnished, signed by not below the rank of Residential Certificate Tahsildar /Deputy tahsildar
Residential/Domicile Certificate stay a minimum of 10 years to be furnished, signed by not below the rank of Tahsildar or Deputy tahsildar
